LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANT CLUB ONE, INC. DBA CLUB ONE FITNESS CENTER'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT OR, IN THE ALTERNATIVE, SUMMARY ADJUDICATION OF CLAIMS - MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION IS GRANTED AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION 1 BECAUSE DEFENDANT IS A SERVICE-PROVIDER. MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS DENIED BECAUSE DEFENDANT HAS NOT CARRIED ITS BURDEN AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION 2 BECAUSE IT HAS NOT SHOWN THAT PLAINTIFF CANNOT PROVE THAT DEFENDANT WAS GROSSLY NEGLIGENT AND THEREFORE HAS NOT SHOWN THAT THE WAIVER WAS A COMPLETE DEFENSE. MR. LONG TO PREPARE FORM OF ORDER PURSUANT TO CCP 437 C(G). (301)

LAW AND MOTION 301, PLAINTIFF NEIL COX'S MOTION TO FILE FIRST AMENDED COMPLAINT IS GRANTED AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION 2 AND CAUSE OF ACTION 3, COUNT I, BUT DENIED AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION 1 BECAUSE THAT CAUSE OF ACTION IS DISMISSED PURSUANT TO THE MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION AND AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION 3, COUNT II BECAUSE IT WOULD FUNDAMENTALLY CHANGE THE NATURE OF THE CASE, TOO CLOSE TO TRIAL AND BECAUSE PLAINTIFF HAS NOT SHOWN EVIDENCE TO SUPPORT THE CLAIM.
